body:
We should be able to use quotes from scientific papers in natural language in different languages as computable math expressions.

We also must be able to have at least all features of being able to compute from all competitors open source (based on tests and code), and closed source (based on their documentation).

We should have automated scripts, that are able to check exactly what we have, and what we have missing.

To implement this vision fully, please carefully plan all the required issues as sub-issues to this issue, and make sure all dependencies between issues are clearly marked as blockers.

The result of this issue itself is pull request with deep analysis and all issues are created in this repository.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).
title: We need to double check that we beat exactly all competitors for math expressions in natural language
